desc: The LanTac LA-SF15 is a no nonsense durable AR-15 Stripped Upper/Lower Receiver Set. This matched receiver set is precision machined from 7075-T6 forgings with a Type 3 hard coat anodized finish. This set can be used with any standard AR caliber build including, of course with the most popular, 223 Remington, 5.56 NATO or .300 AAC blackout if your so inclined. If you're looking for an affordable solid, forged aluminum, AR matched set to start your next build then you're looking for the LanTac LA-SF15 Stripped Upper/Lower Receiver Set!
